capabilities.name: Interactive Assistant
capabilities.description: Talk to the agent like a teammate to ask questions, request info, and take actions directly in Slack.

capabilities.name: Autonomous Monitoring
capabilities.description: Proactively monitors for new information, surfaces context you haven't thought to look for, and takes action.

capabilities.name: Context-Aware Coding Agents
capabilities.description: Debug directly in your coding agent of choice using the intelligence from the platform.

capabilities.name: Engineer-Built Skills
capabilities.description: House your team's custom skills and teach the agent how your team works with plug-in AI connectors.

capabilities.name: Flexible Alert Routing
capabilities.description: Route alerts to the right person or team automatically using pre-built integrations or custom HTTP webhooks.

capabilities.name: Shadow Scheduling
capabilities.description: Create complex on-call schedules, from follow-the-sun to shadow scheduling for easy onboarding.

capabilities.name: AI Alert Intelligence
capabilities.description: Reduces noise by automatically grouping related alerts and intelligently summarizing them to prevent alert fatigue.

capabilities.name: Holiday Feed Sync
capabilities.description: Sync with your HR systems to automatically handle out-of-office dates and seamlessly adjust schedules.

capabilities.name: Slack Group Sync
capabilities.description: Automatically synchronize on-call rotations with Slack user groups so you can easily ping the right people.

capabilities.name: Agentic Root Cause Analysis
capabilities.description: Instantly surfaces an evidence-backed hypothesis identifying what broke and why the moment an incident starts.

capabilities.name: Blast Radius Mapping
capabilities.description: Automatically identifies and visualizes the impact area to understand severity before you begin investigating.

capabilities.name: Parallel Debugging
capabilities.description: The agent runs parallel threads, pulling telemetry and code changes without leaving your terminal.

capabilities.name: Pull Request Drafting
capabilities.description: The agent securely drafts PR fixes based on findings for you to review and merge, never taking action without you.

capabilities.name: Slack-Native Incident Command
capabilities.description: Create and run incidents in seconds using /incident right from Slack or Microsoft Teams.

capabilities.name: Workflow Automation
capabilities.description: Encode and automate key runbooks to operationalize your response and ensure consistent processes.

capabilities.name: Automated Communication
capabilities.description: Share structured incident updates across Slack, SMS, and email to keep stakeholders informed.

capabilities.name: AI-Native Post-Mortems
capabilities.description: Automatically draft post-mortems with a rich timeline and context to focus on learning rather than writing.

capabilities.name: Private Incidents
capabilities.description: Restrict access and lock down sensitive information with dedicated privacy controls during critical events.

capabilities.name: Public, Private & Internal Pages
capabilities.description: Provide tailored status pages for different audiences, from all customers to select partners or internal teams.

capabilities.name: Workflow-Integrated Updates
capabilities.description: Automate status updates entirely or use pre-approved messaging templates right from your incident workflow.

capabilities.name: Multi-Channel Subscriptions
capabilities.description: Allow customers to subscribe to updates for specific components via email, Slack, and RSS.

capabilities.name: Customer Support Integration
capabilities.description: Connect directly with support tools like Intercom to keep agents aligned with engineering context.
